pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN (image rows), origin top-left, units px

camera.notes: fronto-parallel view of a gym wall; ball moves in a plane facing the camera

objects.name: ball
objects.description: pink/red basketball with black seams, the only moving object
objects.reference_point: centre of circle fit (= sphere centre = origin); bbox centre agrees within 1 px
objects.motion: vertical only (x constant 907.0-907.8): drops from rest, bounces once on the floor, rises back to near the start height

objects.name: trophy
objects.description: gold basketball-player trophy (figure holding a ball overhead + cup) on a grey pedestal column with square base, right of the ball
objects.accuracy: +-3 px (manual reading on 2x zoom with 20 px grid)

objects.name: wall
objects.description: teal-green lower wall, y 442-905, behind the ball

objects.name: windows
objects.description: two rows of black window panes in grey frames, y 40-405; pane ~200 px wide x 150 px tall (e.g. x 1010-1218, y 50-200)

objects.name: concrete_pillar
objects.description: grey textured pillar between window groups, x ~835-1000, y 0-440

objects.name: floor
objects.description: orange-brown wooden court floor below y~905; light boundary line along wall at y 917-921; ball's bottom touches y=920 at the bounce

objects.name: court_line
objects.description: light-grey painted stripe on floor running toward camera below the ball, x ~905-925 at y 920 widening to ~875-925 at y 1080

events.note: ball at rest or nearly at rest at frame 0 (fit y 488.1); per-frame drops 0.9, 2.0, 3.5, 5.0 px - consistent with release at frame ~0 from rest
frames 23->24 +22.3 px, 24->25 -20.6 px; impact lies between frames 23 and 25, sampled lowest at 24; no visible squash
rise per frame 47->48 1.7 px, 48->49 0.5 px; apex at or just after last frame; height regained to within ~0.5 px of start
